packageRules.description: Consumer-side `ci.yml`, rendered by THIS layer from `ci.yml.tera` with `how = "overwrite", when = "always"`. Action bumps happen upstream in pj-pnpm and flow down via `kata apply`, so a Renovate-driven local bump is reverted on the next apply and re-opened forever. The canonical pins live in `.kata/vars.toml`, seeded from this layer's `vars.pnpm.toml` — which is where the `# renovate:` annotations that make them bumpable live. Owned here rather than in pj-base because pj-base cannot know that a pnpm layer composes above it, and because `ci.yml` is a name any project may legitimately hand-write.
